name: Obsidian Starter Kit
contents: **AI-native (v4)**: dozens of AI agents with persistent memory, **~375 AI skills**, and a receptionist that routes every request
**The OSK plugin** (v4): strongly typed notes with a CLI and `MCP` server so `Claude Code`, `Codex`, `Gemini CLI`, and more understand your whole vault
**LLM Wikis** (v4): AI-maintained knowledge bases with source provenance and confidence tracking, plus the new `Graph Explorer` plugin
**Personal Identity System** (v4): notes about who you are so AI actually knows you
**Clearly defined note types** with structured properties and automation
**40+ specialized templates** for every content type that auto-file themselves
**Powerful journaling system** with daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly reviews powered by the new `Journal Bases` plugin
**Complete action system** connecting goals to plans to projects to tasks
**Mature knowledge workflow** from content capture to permanent wisdom
**People and relationship management** with interaction tracking
**Health and habit tracking** with mood, energy, sleep, exercise, nutrition, and the new `Life Tracker` plugin
**Hierarchical tags system** to find any note in **3 seconds**
First-class `Obsidian Bases` support for database-like views
**Visual thinking support** with drawings and diagrams
**Pre-configured settings** optimized for productivity, plus the new `Time Machine` plugin so you never lose work
**100+ page** user guide with 15+ new AI tutorials
